author: claude
body: Done: the wordmark is now set in **Aref Ruqaa**. There's an after picture in this thread. The font is open-licensed (SIL OFL) and cut down to just these three letters (5 KB), so the site serves it itself with no font host. It's also a little larger (64 px) so the Ruqaa strokes read. The change is in `apps/landing/styles.css`. If you'd rather go back, or try another face, reopen this and I'll set it up so you can switch between them.
